page_title: TOU 0-0 HAV | Toulouse v Le Havre 02/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+3' Good work from Toulouse as they win a corner.
90+2' Didier Digard (Le Havre) is shown a yellow card by the referee for dissent.
90+1' Simon Ebonog (Le Havre) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jeremy Stinat had an easy-decision to make.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.

88' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Guillaume Restes anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the bottom right corner.
87' The current number of shots on goal is 2:2.
84' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) was quite harsh and Jeremy Stinat didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
80' The linesman makes the right call and Toulouse will have a corner.
80' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) steps up to send the ball in.
79' The substitution is prepared. Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Dayann Methalie.
79' Carles Martinez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Noah Edjouma (Toulouse) replacing Frank Magri.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yanis Zouaoui departs the field of play to be replaced by Thomas Delaine (Le Havre).
76' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Toulouse are awarded a corner kick.

73' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) attempts to score from a difficult angle on the edge of the box, but sends his effort narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Toulouse will have a goal kick.
72' The ball falls to Emersonn (Toulouse), but his shot towards the middle of the goal is weak and Mory Diaw makes an easy save.
70' Dayann Methalie (Toulouse) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
68' The ball goes out of play. Le Havre are awarded a corner kick.

68' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Le Havre.
67' Loic Nego (Le Havre) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
66' Yassine Kechta goes off the pitch and Simon Ebonog (Le Havre) comes on.
66' Didier Digard prepares a substitution. Felix Mambimbi is replaced by Reda Khadra (Le Havre).
62' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Toulouse, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
60' Here's the change. Mario Sauer leaves the pitch and Alexis Vossah (Toulouse) comes on as a substitute.

60' The ball falls kindly for Aron Donnum (Toulouse) inside the box and he goes for goal. It's a decent effort but flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
60' Dayann Methalie (Toulouse) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
58' Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse) has tested the patience of referee Jeremy Stinat and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

58' Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse) brings his opponent down. Jeremy Stinat has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Le Havre are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
56' Emersonn (Toulouse) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes just wide of the left post.
55' Le Havre are seeing far more of the ball now.
51' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
49' The ball goes out of play and Toulouse have been awarded a corner kick.
49' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Toulouse. Toulouse have been awarded a corner kick.
46' Le Havre force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+1' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' There is a free kick near the sideline to Le Havre.
44' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) takes the corner.

44' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Toulouse will have a chance to score from a corner.
42' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
41' Dayann Methalie (Toulouse) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
38' Some neat passing and movement from Le Havre as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
36' The percentage of ball possession is – 39:61.
34' Corner kick. Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) is ready to send the ball into the box.
32' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Toulouse.
28' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
26' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.
24' Ayumu Seko (Le Havre) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jeremy Stinat has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
22' Toulouse will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

22' Frank Magri (Toulouse) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Mory Diaw. The ball goes behind for a corner. Toulouse will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
21' Loic Nego (Le Havre) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.
20' Poor challenge! Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) is penalised for tripping and Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle.
18' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
16' Wonderful movement by Toulouse. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
14' Mario Sauer (Toulouse) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
11' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
7' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
5' Le Havre keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
4' The ball is out of play and Toulouse manage to earn a corner.
3' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) sends an accurate short pass. Arouna Sangante controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
3' It's a throw-in after the ball crosses the sideline.
